name: Anthropic Sandbox Runtime (srt)
summary: Lightweight OS-level sandbox enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on agents, MCP servers and arbitrary processes, without a container.
description: Uses native OS primitives (`sandbox-exec` on macOS, `bubblewrap` on Linux) plus proxy-based network filtering. A beta research preview developed for Claude Code; install with `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime`.
